title: create-enum-helper
summary: Generates a Byte-family record helper (ToByte/FromByte/ToInteger/ FromInteger/ToString/FromString) for an enum type

surfaces.usage: drag-lint create-enum-helper --qname <TEnum> [--apply|--json|--no-backup] [--methods <csv>] [--tostring rtti|case] [--db PATH] - generate a Byte-family record helper for an enum
help: drag-lint create-enum-helper --qname <TEnum> [--apply|--json|--no-backup] [--methods <csv>] [--tostring rtti|case] [--db PATH]  - generate a Byte-family record helper for an enum
